dust_1.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Make a professional VFX TEXTURE sprite, 1024x1024, with a genuinely transparent background and continuously soft variable alpha. One fine DRY GROUND DUST puff. Critical: wisps and all the outside feather slowly to alpha zero. NOT an opaque cloud cutout. Most pixels inside the visible dust are semi-transparent, around 10–60% opacity; the most dense inner pockets never fully opaque. Outer quarter of the puff is barely visible, tapering smoothly to nothing. No defined contour or outline around the mass.
The overall footprint is a roughly round irregular area centered inside 75% of the square, with over 10% completely clear margins. There are only a few broad, shallow folds of soft dust with a loosely dense center. Billows have broad flat granular texture and small shredded wisps, translucent mottled holes, not fluffy puffy white cloud lobes. Dry grit-fine dust in the air just above the ground after a footstep, a sparse chalky haze that is dispersing; no ground, no shadow, no baseline, no vertical plume. Low density, subtle matte smoky dust texture. Fine porous dusty fabric-like density but no textile, not smoke tendrils. Neutral near-white light-gray RGB with soft top lighting, density mostly in ALPHA so it can be tinted by ground color. It must not resemble cotton wool or a fuzzy solid ball. One sprite only, no contact sheet, no text, no backdrop.
Shape variation: a quiet broad central dust billow with two shallow wispy lobes to the upper left and lower right, gently uneven round footprint.

grit.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 1024x1024 grayscale RGBA game VFX texture, genuine transparent background. One loosely dispersed round spray of fine small sand grains and tiny soil crumbs suspended in flight. About 90 clearly separated tiny irregular grains total, with small clusters densest near center, progressively sparser toward edges. Individual grains crisp and irregular/angular, varied sizes from very tiny to a few slightly larger soil crumbs. Most empty space is fully transparent even in center. No pile or surface, no dust cloud or mist, no background or cast shadows, no trails, no glow. Neutral light gray to near-white with subtle overhead illumination. NO color whatsoever. Keep entire spray confined to central 76% of square with at least 10% genuinely empty margin on each side. Loose round distribution, no obvious directional cone or explosion, no radial lines, no text. These grains must survive downsampling to 128px, so roughly 25 are 10–18px diameter at 1024 resolution, the rest 3–9px. Sprite for thrown up sand, suitable for rotating freely.

drop.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 1024x1024 RGBA water droplet game particle sprite on actual transparent background. One perfectly isolated spherical water droplet in flight, centered and occupying about 66% of square width. A single small ROUND liquid water droplet seen close up, neither teardrop nor splash, not sitting on a surface. Neutral near-white/light gray, no hue, no blue. Smooth round full silhouette with a very subtly softened antialiased rim. Soft gray solid body with a clear small bright soft-edged specular highlight in upper left and delicate refracted crescent near lower right, subtle diffuse shading, convincing clear water and liquid surface tension. Droplet center visibly filled and almost opaque, not a hollow bubble. No black hard outline, no lens/camera reflected in droplet, no surrounding drops, no horizon or landscape reflected, no ground, no cast shadow, no glow outside silhouette, no text. At least 12 percent completely transparent margin on all edges. Designed to remain legible as a water droplet at 32 and 128 pixels.

ripple.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production 1024x1024 RGBA game ripple particle sprite, genuine transparent background.
One single circular THIN soft bright water ripple crest, viewed precisely straight down from above on perfectly still water. A continuous delicate light gray to near-white ring, almost circular with just very subtle organic variation in brightness, centered at canvas center. Outer diameter 76 percent of image width, visible ring width approximately 1 percent of image width. Ring edges softly feather into transparency. Absolutely everything INSIDE AND OUTSIDE this one narrow ring is fully transparent. Only the crest line is visible. No filled disc, no solid water surface, no reflection inside circle, no sphere, no bubble, no drop, no splash, no extra nested/concentric rings, no secondary ring, no cast shadow, no glow radiating far out. Neutral grayscale only, no blue, no hue. Thin softly lit water wavefront, not thick white rubber torus or metal hoop. Round shape with equal width and height, no perspective tilt. At least 10 percent completely transparent border on all sides. No text.
